notes: Pages opened (2 of 1-2): List of Zhou dynasty states, Chu (state). No separate Wikipedia article was found under the titles tried, so identity.wikipedia is null; Wikidata id left null (unreachable). SOURCE: one table row, read twice (columns: Name of state | Hanzi | Family | Present location | Title | Start and end year | Conqueror). The row's 1040 is a list figure, not a sentence (confidence 2). The list names two counties, Zhengyang and Xi; the disc is at Zhengyang and overlaps the xi dossier's disc at Xi County (about 20 km). The chu dossier draws Jiang (江) as Zhumadian 40 km, which is not a gazetteer place. A second state with the same sound, Jiang (蔣), is jiang-gushi. In 658 BC Jiang and Huang made a covenant with Qi and Song (huang dossier). The disc and the capital dot are the researcher's reading of the county or town named in the row (coordinates, since the gazetteer lacks most of these places). AREA: none. No rulers, no capitals, no wars on the list.
